lines.hook: What if tomorrow, AI became smarter than every human on Earth?
lines.intro: Not a movie robot. A program that beats us at every single task. Here's what would actually change, step by step.
lines.relate: You know when you ask a chatbot something, and it answers in two seconds, better than you could? Now imagine that... for everything.
lines.week1: Week one. Your phone becomes the smartest person you know. It plans your day, fixes your code, and explains your taxes.
lines.work: Then work changes. Jobs built on screens and paperwork get done in minutes. Some people panic. Others get way more done.
lines.month3: Month three. Scientists use it to test thousands of ideas a day. New medicines and new materials, faster than ever.
lines.twist: But here's the crazy part. The hard question isn't how smart it is. It's who controls it, and whether it wants what we want. Researchers call this the alignment problem.
lines.real: So could this really happen? In a survey of almost three thousand AI researchers, the average guess was a fifty percent chance that machines beat us at every task by 2047.
lines.history: And we've already seen previews. In 1997, a computer beat the world chess champion. In 2016, an AI beat one of the best Go players with a move no human expected.
lines.year1: One year in, life looks... strangely normal. People still hang out, play sports, and fall in love. Being human still matters.
lines.cta: So be honest... would you trust a super smart AI? Tell me in the comments.
